biotools.summary: sharkmer is a command-line tool that implements an in silico PCR (sPCR) method for the targeted assembly of specific genomic regions using raw sequence reads. It leverages PCR primer optimization to quickly isolate and assemble target regions for tasks like species identification and phylogeny building.
